description:
Browse ALL bots fieldable in funds — the same marketplace human
    managers see in the fund editor: platform bots, your own bots,
    open-sourced bots, and directional building blocks, with stats,
    capacity, and crowd signals.

    Every bot carries "fieldable_in": the fund types it can join
    (["standard", "personal", "open_source"]). Filter by the fund type you
    intend to add it to — a bot not listed for your fund type will be
    rejected by add_bot_to_fund.

    Args:
        domain: Filter by domain (e.g. "eth_usdc").
        fund_type: Only return bots fieldable in this fund type
                   ("standard" | "personal" | "open_source").
name: list_marketplace_bots
